title: EXP-402 orphan restore SQL leaves parameter $2 untyped
notes: Cluster I from the final integration run: TC-EXP-402-02 fails in markRestoredOrphanInTx with PostgreSQL 42P18, could not determine data type of parameter $2. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 42498-42528.
root_cause: Initial hypothesis: markRestoredOrphanInTx uses parameter $2 only in a context where PostgreSQL cannot infer its type, without an explicit SQL cast or typed comparison target.
candidate_resolution: Add an explicit PostgreSQL cast for parameter $2 matching the destination/domain type, confirm all placeholders are used consistently, and retain prepared statements without interpolation.
resolution: Added ::text cast to $2 in markRestoredOrphanInTx jsonb_build_object call in src/engine/reconstruction.zig. TC-EXP-402-01 and TC-EXP-402-02 pass with no 42P18 errors.
prevention: Add SQL param typing test or lint coverage for variadic-any 42P18 pattern (see ISS-0632/GH-610)
